---
title: "Functions and methods"
---

All classes and functions are in the `CmdStan` namespace. Standalone functions keep CmdStanR's snake_case names. Methods and their parameters are camelCase, so CmdStanR's `fit$output_files()` is `$fit->outputFiles()`, and [Compatibility](compatibility.qmd#method-names) maps every renamed method. CmdStan's option names are unchanged.

Inference methods accept PHP named arguments or one associative options array, and they reject unknown options. An option left out or set to `null` uses the installed CmdStan's default.

| Page | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Functions](api-functions.qmd) | Standalone functions: models and Stan files, CmdStan installation, data and CSV files, figures, and examples |
| [Options](api-options.qmd) | Session options, shared options, and each method's options |
| [CmdStanModel](api-models.qmd) | Creating, inspecting, and running a model |
| [Fits](api-fits.qmd) | Draws, summaries, diagnostics, files, and model methods of fits |
| [Data frames](api-data-frames.qmd) | Table data, `StanData`, and `Tables` |
| [Helper classes](api-helpers.qmd) | `Figure`, `Plot`, `StanFunctions`, `ModelMethods`, and the statistics classes |
| [Errors](api-errors.qmd) | Exceptions |
